about: BATCH 14, CARD 74 (his pick C, run-answers orchestrator-B14-Q2-2026-11-24): on a 320x568 phone opened from its Home Screen icon Review's button row thins 44 -> 32, icons only, with the move arrows the solid triangles, and the board grows 301 -> 313; every other phone keeps the 44 row. Graded by gate 228 (TC-R381..384) at the 320x568 Home Screen app (real inset 20/0, the 568 shell), 320x568 in Safari (no insets) and 375x761 kunal761.
